title: P5-09b: copy-backend: Message rows with null composite-index sort-key fields fail on the new schema; exact-key S3 selection

comments.author: home
comments.text: Evidence (from PPY-e20cab copy agent): copy-backend --apply copied 24,105 of 26,636 rows. Model Message wrote 941 of 3,472; all 2,531 failures carry the same error: target AppSync index messagesByResponseTargetStatusCreatedAt requires a value in its composite sort key but source rows leave those fields null. Second limit: the tool adds a trailing slash to every --s3-prefixes entry so a single key (corpora/papyrus-steering.yml) cannot be selected. Plan: investigate Message index + app convention, generic schema-driven key-field default, add --s3-keys, tests, docs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed: PR #183 squash-merged to develop as 58834793e2a01256794f554afebfe1cdda01ca65. Release run succeeded: npm @anthusai/papyrus 1.0.0-next.38 (next), PyPI papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev38. Tests: 27 copy-backend scenarios and the backend BDD suite pass; the new Message scenario failed before the fix (2 rows rejected: composite sort key requires responseStatus). Live read-only dry run predicts 2531 Message rows given key defaults, ok=true, 0 invalid.

right_now_summary: The fix now defaults missing Message index keys, supports exact S3 keys, and passes tests and dry-run checks.
